mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_tool_log ( trace_id, user_id, user_message, tool_name, tool_desc, tool_class, method_name, arguments_json, result_text, status, error_message, duration_ms, create_time ) VALUES ( #{traceId}, #{userId}, #{userMessage}, #{toolName}, #{toolDesc}, #{toolClass}, #{methodName}, #{argumentsJson}, #{resultText}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, #{durationMs}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, trace_id AS traceId, user_id AS userId, user_message AS userMessage, tool_name AS toolName, tool_desc AS toolDesc, tool_class AS toolClass, method_name AS methodName, arguments_json AS argumentsJson, result_text AS resultText, status, error_message AS errorMessage, duration_ms AS durationMs, create_time AS createTime FROM agent_tool_log WHERE id = #{id}
